Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: decision-needed.

Figure rebinding is an in-place undoable BindFigure; no version model is persisted. The ticket explicitly offers persistence versus copy correction, requiring a product decision.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/command/Reducer.scala:451-463 rebuilds and replaces one FigureSpec on BindFigure
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/document/Reporting.scala:307-325 FigureSpec contains id/run/reporting/panels, no version history

Remaining / next action: Choose persisted figure versions with a schema migration, or revise the inspector copy and test the chosen contract.

Disposition: Keep open.
